paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel, son of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani: Berakhot 28b; Shabbat 80a. Hillel bar Shmuel bar Nachman: Midrash Shmuel chapter 15; Midrash Chazit chapter 8; beginning of Kohelet; Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Sheviit chapter 6, and Kiddushin chapter 1. Rabbi Levi his brother, and Rav Nachman.
